camel_example: aliyun sas DescribePropertyUserDetail --region cn-hangzhou --IsRoot 0 --User bin --Uuid '50d213b4-3a35-427a-b8a5-04b0c7e10000' --PageSize 10 --NextToken E17B501887A2D3AA5E8360A6EFA3B000 --CurrentPage 1 --LastLoginTimeEnd 1651298836000 --Extend 1 --LastLoginTimeStart 164922523600 --ResourceDirectoryAccountId 1 --UseNextToken false --Remark '192.168.XX.XX'
description_en: Queries the Asset Fingerprints information of account assets on a server
description_zh: 查询服务器的账户资产的指纹信息
kebab_example: aliyun sas describe-property-user-detail --remark 192.168.XX.XX --user bin --is-root 0 --uuid 50d213b4-3a35-427a-b8a5-04b0c7e10000 --current-page 1 --page-size 10 --last-login-time-start 164922523600 --last-login-time-end 1651298836000 --extend 1 --use-next-token false --next-token E17B501887A2D3AA5E8360A6EFA3B000 --resource-directory-account-id 1 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribePropertyUserDetail

parameters.help_en: The name or IP address of the server to query
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的服务器的名称或IP地址
parameters.name: remark

parameters.help_en: The account name on the server to query
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的服务器的账户名称
parameters.name: user

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the account to query has ROOT permissions. Valid values:

0: No.
1: Yes
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的账户是否拥有ROOT权限。取值包括：

0：否
1：是
parameters.name: is_root

parameters.help_en: The UUID of the server to query
parameters.name: uuid

parameters.help_en: The page number of the page to return in a paginated query. Default value: 1, which indicates the first page
parameters.help_zh: 设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。默认值为1，表示从第1页开始显示
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of account asset fingerprint entries per page in a paging query. Default value: 10, which indicates 10 account asset fingerprint entries per page
parameters.help_zh: 设置分页查询时，每页显示的账户资产的指纹信息的数量。默认值为10，表示每页显示10条账户资产的指纹信息
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The start timestamp for querying the last logon time of the account. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 账户上次登录检索的开始时间戳。单位为毫秒
parameters.name: last_login_time_start

parameters.help_en: The end timestamp for querying the last logon time of the account. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 账户上次登录检索的结束时间戳。单位为毫秒
parameters.name: last_login_time_end

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether fuzzy match is supported for account names. Set this parameter to 1 to enable fuzzy match. Any other value or an empty value indicates that fuzzy match is not supported
parameters.help_zh: 账户名称是否支持模糊查询。要设置支持模糊查询时，请将该参数的取值设置为1，其他值或取值为空则表示不支持模糊查询
parameters.name: extend

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use the NextToken method to retrieve the vulnerability list data. If this parameter is used, TotalCount is no longer returned. Valid values:

true: Uses the NextToken method.
false: Does not use the NextToken method
parameters.help_zh:
是否使用NextToken方式拉取漏洞列表数据。如果使用此参数TotalCount不再返回。取值：

true：使用NextToken方式。
false：不使用NextToken方式
parameters.name: use_next_token

parameters.help_en:
The token that marks the current position from which to start reading. Leave this parameter empty to start from the beginning.

Do not specify this parameter for the first call. The response includes the NextToken value for the second call. Each subsequent response contains the NextToken value for the next call
parameters.help_zh:
用来标记当前开始读取的位置，置空表示从头开始。

第一次调用不用填写，会在返回结果中包含第二次调用时用的NextToken，之后每次调用返回结果中都有下一次调用时的NextToken
parameters.name: next_token
